rubric.role_summary: Hands-on mechatronics hardware engineering for industrial robot autonomy and learning. Integrate and improve commercially available robots, develop reproducible retrofit kits, and troubleshoot and document physical systems.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Hands-on mechatronics hardware engineering for industrial robot autonomy and learning. Integrate and improve commercially available robots, develop reproducible retrofit kits, and troubleshoot and document physical systems.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Hands-on experience designing and building mechatronic or robotic hardware.
- Hands-on mechanical design experience using CAD.
- Hands-on experience with electrical wiring, harnesses, or electrical troubleshooting.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience integrating industrial arms, mobile manipulators, force and torque sensors, grippers, or dexterous hands.
- Experience with robot-cell safeguarding, safety-rated components, or machinery risk assessment.
- Experience designing teleoperation devices, camera calibration fixtures, or data collection hardware.
- Familiarity with Python, ROS 2, or CAD-to-URDF workflows for working with software teammates.
- Designed, assembled, and deployed mechatronic or robotic hardware that operated reliably beyond a CAD model or bench test.
- Strong CAD skills and hands-on experience with rapid prototyping, machining or fabrication vendors, mechanical assembly, and design iteration.
- Practical understanding of loads, stiffness, tolerances, fasteners, cable routing, and mounting tradeoffs for sensors and actuators.
- Experience with low-voltage power, connectors, harnesses, and electrical troubleshooting using a multimeter and oscilloscope.
- Experience writing test procedures, bills of materials, assembly instructions, and maintenance documentation for physical systems.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
